svg.title: Speed profiles – trapezoid, triangle and S-curve (J1 home → pick, IRB 2600)
svg.text: S-curve: ramp in t_j = a/j = 0.05 s
T_c ≥ t_a → T = T_c + t_a = 0.682 s (trapezoid)
the axis with the longest time leads (here J1)
all other axes are slowed down to the same T
→ smooth path, lowest load on the mechanics
choose t_j ≈ ¼ … ½ of the arm's natural period
the S-curve costs ≈ t_j per move
